lead.headline: Wembanyama Drops 40 and Nine Blocks as Spurs Win Ninth Straight
lead.subhead: San Antonio opened the season 0-2 and hasn't lost since. Victor Wembanyama turned the rim into a no-go zone in a 122-96 win at Phoenix. A slow start is not the story; the streak after it is.

articles.hed: Flagg Scores 43 as Dallas Rallies Late
articles.body: Down 13 to Indiana, the Mavericks won the fourth quarter 35-29. Cooper Flagg finished with 43 points and 10 rebounds, Kyrie Irving added 35, and Dallas closed out a 125-122 win. Down big, still found the finish.

The Bears already struck early for Jeffery Simmons, and Jacksonville went all in Monday with three defensive deals. Every contender is working the phones today. Front offices that move with urgency set the tone for the second half.

openingBell.title: The Opening Bell
openingBell.intro: Tuesday, the day of Mars. Four counts in, four hold, four out, four hold. Mars is the warrior's planet: drive, courage, the first strike. Breathe like a fighter before the bell.

breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Empty and steady. Reset the line.

breathing.close: Four rounds squares the mind. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then go take Tuesday.

mindset.hed: Ninth Straight Starts With the Third
mindset.body: The Spurs were 0-2 and nobody was talking about them. Nine wins later, they're the story. The Mavs were down 13 and still closed. Sales is a streak game: one good call makes the next one easier. Start the streak this morning with the first dial. Competitive. Unbeatable. Always rising. fall down 7 stand up 8.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Tuesday, the day of Mars: run this right after Morning Charge. Dawn is clear and about 41°, so the RipStick finisher can go on the porch if you want the fresh air. Fast, aggressive reps.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom's RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time.

items.hed: Anthropic ships Claude Fable 5.2, up to 30% faster
items.body: Fable 5.2 reached the Claude API, AWS, Google Cloud and Azure on Nov 9 with a lower price than 5.1 and about 55% fewer safeguard blocks. Mythos 5.2 stays limited to vetted researchers.

items.hed: Grok Bot expands to SuperGrok and Cursor plans; Apple races on agentic Siri
items.body: Grok Bot is now available on SuperGrok, Cursor Pro and Cursor Teams plans. Separately, Bloomberg reports Apple CEO John Ternus is pushing Siri to control native apps in iOS 27.3.

items.hed: OpenAI teams up with Hacktron on security testing
items.body: OpenAI engineers will work with Hacktron researchers to probe high-priority areas, especially connections between OpenAI systems and outside services.

items.hed: Wemby 40-11-9 as Spurs win ninth straight
items.body: Victor Wembanyama had 40 points, 11 rebounds and nine blocks in a 122-96 win at Phoenix. San Antonio won the glass 55-35.

items.hed: Warriors rout Pelicans 138-87 for eighth straight
items.body: Stephen Curry and Brandin Podziemski scored 25 apiece. Curry passed DeMar DeRozan for 16th on the career scoring list.

items.hed: Luka back with 32 and 10 as Lakers win sixth straight
items.body: Doncic returned to lead a 124-114 win in Atlanta. Flagg scored 43 in Dallas' comeback over Indiana, and Houston beat Denver 110-100.

items.hed: Jaguars go all in before the deadline
items.body: Jacksonville added Jordan Davis, Jessie Bates and Davon Godchaux on Monday. More trades are expected before 4 PM ET today.

items.hed: Bills smother Vikings 23-6 on Monday night
items.body: Buffalo's defense held Minnesota to 81 passing yards, and the Vikings are now under pressure to find a quarterback by the deadline.

items.hed: Trade grades for every deal so far
items.body: Kevin Patra grades every move since the season started, including Chicago's early Jeffery Simmons blockbuster and Detroit's pickup of Andre Cisco.
Ciryl Gane defends heavyweight gold against unbeaten Josh Hokit Saturday at Madison Square Garden, with Kayla Harrison vs. Amanda Nunes in the co-main.

items.hed: Hokit says Jones gave him the blueprint
items.body: Hokit (10-0) points to Jon Jones' first-round guillotine of Gane as proof his Jackson-Wink coaches know how to beat the champion.

items.hed: Alatengheili added to UFC 334 on a week's notice
items.body: The veteran steps in against unbeaten Juan Diaz, and Stephen Thompson still meets Charles Radtke in his retirement fight.

Tuesday is ruled by Mars: iron, fire, courage and decisive action. Old grimoires set it aside for workings of strength and victory. Pick the one hard conversation or ask you've been avoiding and make it today.

items.hed: The Pistis Sophia and the thirteen repentances
items.body: In this Gnostic text, Sophia cries out thirteen times before she is lifted from chaos. The lesson is persistence: the breakthrough came after the thirteenth try, not the first. Keep asking.

items.hed: Meister Eckhart on doing the work
items.body: The medieval mystic taught that God is found as much in the kitchen as in the chapel, if the work is done wholeheartedly. Give your most ordinary task today full attention and see what it gives back.

grimoire.title: Grimoire
grimoire.source: From the wisdom attributed to Solomon
grimoire.body: Solomon wrote: 'Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend' (Proverbs 27:17). Edges are made by contact, not isolation. The people you talk shop with shape how sharp you get.
